rules.scope: Development hypotheses chosen after earlier development comparisons; not independently validated
rules.semanticOutput: uint8 HxW ADE150 at the exact same upright source grid, no resize inside merger
rules.skyObservationMask: semantic output == 2; identical to evaluated fused map. Positive n640 override plus retained base sky can increase sky false positives.
rules.standaloneN640Sky: comparison output only, not used as separate downstream mask
rules.personCount: object detector observations only; semantic person area is not added to box count

role: New development hypotheses chosen after prior development results; not independent validation
selection: Apply unchanged original screening to each F1/F2; no automatic deployment or retuning
